name: context-guard
description: Per-session context-window observability. A mod writes each session's context-window figures to a snapshot file and shows the person a toast and a transcript line when the context zone (smart, acceptable or dumb, from bands in zones.json) worsens; with model_notices on (off by default) it also tells Claude the zone at each crossing, approach and compaction. /context-guard prints status and toggles an optional band row. It answers a status tool. A PostCompact hook leaves a marker.

context_guard_hooks_enabled.title: Zone notices and compaction marker
context_guard_hooks_enabled.description: Runs the module's zone lines and toasts and the PostCompact marker hook. On by default; off, none of them acts. Snapshot writes continue either way.

model_notices.title: Model notices
model_notices.description: Sends Claude one line when the session crosses into a worse context zone, approaches a boundary, or passes a zones.json threshold, and restates the zone after a compaction, a resume or a reload. Off by default; the toast, transcript line, band row, status tool and snapshot work either way.

zone_report_mode.title: Zone report mode
zone_report_mode.description: Acts only with model_notices on. automatic (default) sends the lines to Claude; operator holds them in a turn a person typed and offers the person a ready-made prompt and a notice row when the turn ends. Headless, loop and schedule turns get automatic lines either way.

zone_line_data.title: Zone line data
zone_line_data.description: Comma list of what a line carries beside its zone, which every line has: percent, tokens and window. Default zone.

context_guard_band.title: Context band row
context_guard_band.description: Draws the context figure and zone in a row above the prompt. Off by default. Turn it on in /config, or for one session with /context-guard band on.

context_guard_toast.title: Zone-change toast
context_guard_toast.description: Shows a short toast when the session crosses into a worse context zone, beside the transcript line that records it. On by default; off, only the transcript line remains.
